records.purpose: Add delta to one named stat of your own player through the game's stat-adjust function; the game clamps it and applies its own consequences. Read the stat back to see what took effect.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*adjust)(sco_plugin* self, uint64_t id, uint32_t stat, float delta);`
Add delta to one named stat of your own player through the game's stat-adjust function; the game clamps it and applies its own consequences. Read the stat back to see what took effect.
records.ownership: Copied scalar inputs; nothing copied out, no allocation, no engine pointer transfer, nothing retained. No lease: the write is a one-shot game adjust.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; WRONG_THREAD elsewhere before any game access.
records.reentrancy: Calls the game's own stat-adjust function once under a fault guard; no plugin re-entry.
records.results: OK adjusted; BAD_ARG null or released self, id 0 or not your player, stat not a 1.0 stat, a non-finite input or a step past SC_ACTOR_STATS_WRITE_MAX_STEP; NOT_FOUND not spawned or no record of that stat; UNAVAILABLE game.actor_stats.write off or no fresh offline admission; FAILED game fault; WRONG_THREAD off the game thread.
records.absent_capability: Table absent: query_service NOT_FOUND. game.actor_stats.write is OFF by default (product switch or SCO_ACTOR_STATS_WRITE=1, plus its rows and game.actor_stats.read); while it is off, or the session is not certified offline, adjust and set answer UNAVAILABLE.
records.cleanup: Nothing is restored on unload: the stats are gameplay state the game changes every tick. game.actors' stop withdraws the table and clears the capability.
limitations: Static evidence on 4.10.197.2878 (F-4.10.197.2878-010); not run in game.
Whether a write persists in an offline session or is overwritten by the game's simulation is not known; capability OFF.
The game ignores hunger, thirst and blood-drug changes while their pl_status.enable* switch is off.
Your own player only in 1.0; no C# or Lua route.

evidence.token: The C# and Lua game.actor_stats routes are unsupported in 1.0, for reads and writes.

records.buffer_contract:
